title: Engineering command interface
description: Interpret supported public command requests and present their actual scoped outcomes through the declared request, result, help, and exit contracts.
responsibilities: Admit commands, versions, selectors, and explicit inputs under the selected public contract.
Dispatch operational-record requests to their persistence contract and installation requests to the installation contract without making engineering judgments.
Present bounded observations, diagnostics, omitted-detail access, and exit outcomes without hiding actual side effects or sensitive information.

Select recorded changes and requested record projections under literal public query rules; preserve complete-source and omission distinctions and handle bounded private invocation diagnostics under the owning CLI contract.
owned_state: Admitted command context, rendered results, and optional bounded private invocation diagnostics under the current logging contract; authoritative project records and installation destinations have separate owners.

includes: Published command admission, scoped access, dispatch, results, and diagnostics.
excludes: Inferring authoritative workflow decisions, accepting REM authoring JSON as current operational records, granting authority, or treating successful parsing as a committed update.

design_limits: Existing CLI public envelopes, version domains, selectors, and exceptional command behavior remain specified by docs/design/cli/cli.md; the new logical Interfaces summarize responsibility and preserve that authority.
Detailed AR derivation and realization mapping for this product extension remain deferred. The draft does not change any public command or package.

sources.basis: Proposed responsibility derived from the published-product source inventory. Existing Designs retain their detailed contracts; this allocation is not a runtime migration or approval.
